notes.title: So U Survived?
notes.notes:
The test has successfully ended!

 [b]24 257[/b] players tried the demo, and Lu was saved no less than [b]14 554[/b] times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569200/2a34a1a56dd269122591807c6ae460e274537400.gif[/img]

Thanks to your support, we were able to quickly spot and fix issues — and understand where to move forward.

Huge thank you to all of you! And now… attention please… *drumroll*

[b]BIG NEWS![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569200/0ca05462da4a1ca43a550ffc0bf13826101fec02.gif[/img]

THE BUS IS REAL , and on May 26th we’ll show you an all-new, awesome bus customizer!

Alongside it comes an updated demo version with fixes based on your feedback. 🎉
